# Rochman Ramadhani Chiefto Irawan

> Rochman Ramadhani Chiefto Irawan, S.Kom. ("Oman") is a Forward Deployed Engineer and Product Engineer in Jakarta, Indonesia who helps Indonesian business owners grow with AI and well-built systems. He is the Founder of Skolain, a school management platform, Technology Partner at a multi-brand beauty group, and an AI Learning Partner to business owners. He has 6+ years (since July 2020) of experience building production systems for banking, healthcare, government and education.

Key facts, all documented on the landing page:

- Founder & Product Engineer, Skolain (since June 2026): five school modules in one workflow, 1,600+ active users.
- Contracted three times by PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI): Backend Developer on New Delivery System (NDS) and QLOLA (wholesale digital banking), then Senior Software Engineer on NDS (December 2022 to December 2025).
- Senior Software Engineer, Telkom Indonesia, Omni Communication Assistant (OCA), August 2024 to January 2025: proposed, planned and led a NestJS → Go backend migration to improve resource efficiency and resilience under peak traffic.
- Architected PrimaSejahtera, a national HRIS for PT PKSS with 50,000+ active users.
- Software Architect leading 6 engineers on the Health, Safety & Environment system of Siloam International Hospitals, 500+ daily users.
- Product Engineer on FRAMES (Faculty of Medicine Universitas Indonesia × Garuda Indonesia Training Center): v1 October to December 2020, v2 released 7 March 2024.
- Product Engineer on the Kolegium Dokter membership dashboard, scoped for 150,000 general practitioners.
- Engineering Manager (part-time, hybrid), PT Mastah Digital Teknologi, July 2025 to May 2026. Lead Software Engineer at PT Lumos Inisiatif Indonesia, team grown from 7 to 30+.
- Awards: 1st place, SEAMEO SEAMOLEC Southeast Asia Creative Camp batch 3 (January 2019) with Smart Green Garden, an automatic IoT plant-watering system; 1st place, Kamp Kreatif SMK Indonesia 2019 with Ngajar; 1st place, PermataYouthPreneur 2020 with Bayar.
- Education: B.Sc. (S.Kom.) Information Systems, BINUS Online Learning, 3.85 GPA, Magna Cum Laude (August 2026); SMK Negeri 26 Jakarta (2017 to 2021).
